labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Rich strips \r from rendered text; redrawing a line is done with Live/Progress, so this is a usage question.

body:
Rich strips carriage returns (`\r`) from text it renders, so `rich.print()` cannot redraw a line the way the built-in `print()` does. For an in-place updating line, use [`Live`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst) (or `Progress`, which is built on it). For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions); the maintainer converts or closes them.
